props.custom_logic_action:
/**

* Pases · Custom Logic (Action Phase) — v0.5

*

* Fixes:

* - Resolve passive owner from stable passive metadata / passive item parent.

* - Do NOT treat payload.targets as the owner.

* - Do NOT mix passive self-target arrays into event target checks.

* - Only increment Adoration when the OWNER was the target of the MISSED action.

* - Reset Adoration only when the OWNER actually takes positive damage.

*/

const TAG = "[Pases][CL-Action]";

const DEBUG_PASES = true;

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Tuning knobs

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const ADORATION_GAIN_ON_MISS = 1; // <- change this number anytime you want

const payload =

(typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD)

? __PAYLOAD

: (globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {});

const targets =

(typeof __TARGETS !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(__TARGETS))

? __TARGETS

: (Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS) ? globalThis.__TARGETS : []);

const ctx =

(typeof context !== "undefined" && context)

? context

: {};

const log = (...a) => { if (DEBUG_PASES) console.log(TAG, ...a); };

const warn = (...a) => { if (DEBUG_PASES) console.warn(TAG, ...a); };

const err = (...a) => { if (DEBUG_PASES) console.error(TAG, ...a); };

function clamp(n, min, max) {

n = Number(n) || 0;

return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));

}

function num(v, d = null) {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : d;

}

function str(v, d = "") {

const s = (v ?? "").toString().trim();

return s.length ? s : d;

}

function uniq(arr) {

return [...new Set((Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []).filter(Boolean).map(v => String(v).trim()).filter(Boolean))];

}

function isTokenUuid(v) {

return typeof v === "string" && /\.Token\./.test(v);

}

function isActorUuid(v) {

return typeof v === "string" && /^Actor\./.test(v);

}

async function docFromUuidSafe(uuid) {

if (!uuid) return null;

try {

return await fromUuid(uuid);

} catch {

return null;

}

}

function passiveTriggerKey() {

return str(

payload?.meta?.passiveTriggerKey ??

payload?.reaction_trigger_key ??

payload?.meta?.triggerKey ??

ctx?.passiveTriggerKey ??

""

);

}

function getPhaseEvent() {

const key = passiveTriggerKey();

const byKey = payload?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload_by_trigger?.[key];

const metaEvt = payload?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload;

const topEvt = payload?.reaction_phase_payload;

const evt = byKey || metaEvt || topEvt || {};

return { key, evt };

}

function chooseDefenseToUse() {

const pref = str(

payload?.dataCore?.defense_target_type ??

payload?.core?.defense_target_type ??

payload?.sourceItem?.system?.props?.defense_target_type ??

payload?.meta?.defense_target_type ??

""

).toLowerCase();

if (pref === "mdef" || /mag(ic)?\s*def/i.test(pref) || /mdef/i.test(pref)) return "mdef";

if (pref === "def" || /defense/i.test(pref)) return "def";

const isSpellish = !!(

payload?.dataCore?.isSpell ||

payload?.meta?.isSpellish ||

/spell/i.test(String(payload?.core?.skillTypeRaw ?? payload?.dataCore?.skillTypeRaw ?? ""))

);

return isSpellish ? "mdef" : "def";

}

function readOwnerDefense(defenseSnapshot, which) {

try {

const snap = defenseSnapshot || payload?.meta?.defenseSnapshot || {};

const p = snap.primary || {};

return (which === "mdef") ? num(p.mdef, 0) : num(p.def, 0);

} catch {

return 0;

}

}

function readAccuracyTotal() {

const cands = [

payload?.accuracy?.total,

payload?.meta?.accuracyTotal,

payload?.advPayload?.accuracyTotal,

payload?.dataCore?.accuracyTotal,

payload?.accuracyTotal

];

for (const c of cands) {

const n = num(c, null);

if (n !== null) return n;

}

return null;

}

function computeFinalDamageEstimate() {

const base = num(payload?.advPayload?.baseValue, 0) ?? 0;

const bonus = num(payload?.advPayload?.bonus, 0) ?? 0;

const reduction = num(payload?.advPayload?.reduction, 0) ?? 0;

const multRaw = num(payload?.advPayload?.multiplier, 100);

const mult = (multRaw > 10) ? (multRaw / 100) : multRaw;

const raw = (base + bonus - reduction) * mult;

return Math.max(0, Math.round(raw));

}

async function resolveOwnerFromPassiveItem() {

const itemUuid =

payload?.meta?.passiveItemUuid ??

payload?.skillUuid ??

payload?.skill_uuid ??

null;

const itemDoc = await docFromUuidSafe(itemUuid);

const item = itemDoc?.documentName === "Item" || itemDoc?.constructor?.name === "Item"

? itemDoc

: null;

const actor = item?.actor ?? item?.parent ?? null;

if (!actor) return { actor: null, token: null, ownerActorUuid: null, ownerTokenUuid: null, via: "none" };

let token = null;

try {

token = actor.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? actor.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ?? null;

} catch (_) {}

return {

actor,

token,

ownerActorUuid: actor?.uuid ?? null,

ownerTokenUuid: token?.document?.uuid ?? token?.uuid ?? null,

via: "passive_item_parent"

};

}

async function getOwnerActorAndToken() {

// 1) Best: explicit owner meta

let ownerTokenUuid =

payload?.meta?.ownerTokenUuid ??

null;

let ownerActorUuid =

payload?.meta?.ownerActorUuid ??

null;

// 2) Next: attacker meta from auto-passive payload (owner of the passive)

if (!ownerTokenUuid) {

const attTok =

payload?.meta?.attackerTokenUuid ??

(isTokenUuid(payload?.meta?.attackerUuid) ? payload.meta.attackerUuid : null) ??

(isTokenUuid(payload?.attackerUuid) ? payload.attackerUuid : null) ??

(isTokenUuid(payload?.attacker_uuid) ? payload.attacker_uuid : null) ??

null;

ownerTokenUuid = attTok || ownerTokenUuid;

}

if (!ownerActorUuid) {

const attAct =

payload?.meta?.attackerActorUuid ??

(isActorUuid(payload?.meta?.attackerUuid) ? payload.meta.attackerUuid : null) ??

(isActorUuid(payload?.attackerUuid) ? payload.attackerUuid : null) ??

(isActorUuid(payload?.attacker_uuid) ? payload.attacker_uuid : null) ??

null;

ownerActorUuid = attAct || ownerActorUuid;

}

// 3) Resolve direct docs if possible

let tokenDoc = ownerTokenUuid ? await docFromUuidSafe(ownerTokenUuid) : null;

let actorDoc = ownerActorUuid ? await docFromUuidSafe(ownerActorUuid) : null;

let token = tokenDoc?.object ?? tokenDoc ?? null;

let actor =

token?.actor ??

tokenDoc?.actor ??

(actorDoc?.documentName === "Actor" ? actorDoc : actorDoc?.actor ?? null) ??

null;

// 4) Fallback: derive from passive item parent

if (!actor) {

const viaItem = await resolveOwnerFromPassiveItem();

actor = viaItem.actor ?? actor;

token = viaItem.token ?? token;

ownerActorUuid = ownerActorUuid ?? viaItem.ownerActorUuid ?? null;

ownerTokenUuid = ownerTokenUuid ?? viaItem.ownerTokenUuid ?? null;

}

// 5) Final sync from resolved docs

ownerActorUuid = ownerActorUuid ?? actor?.uuid ?? null;

ownerTokenUuid = ownerTokenUuid ?? token?.document?.uuid ?? token?.uuid ?? null;

// 6) If token still missing but actor exists, try active token lookup

if (!token && actor) {

try {

token = actor.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? actor.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ?? null;

ownerTokenUuid = ownerTokenUuid ?? token?.document?.uuid ?? token?.uuid ?? null;

} catch (_) {}

}

return {

ownerTokenUuid,

ownerActorUuid,

tokenDoc,

token,

actor

};

}

async function getSourceActorAndToken() {

const { evt } = getPhaseEvent();

const tokenishRefs = uniq([

evt?.attackerUuid,

evt?.sourceUuid,

evt?.tokenUuid,

evt?.subjectTokenUuid

]);

for (const ref of tokenishRefs) {

const doc = await docFromUuidSafe(ref);

if (!doc) continue;

if (doc?.documentName === "Token" || doc?.documentName === "TokenDocument") {

const token = doc?.object ?? doc;

return {

token,

actor: token?.actor ?? doc?.actor ?? null,

sourceTokenUuid: token?.document?.uuid ?? doc?.uuid ?? null,

sourceActorUuid: token?.actor?.uuid ?? null

};

}

if (doc?.documentName === "Actor") {

let token = null;

try {

token = doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? doc.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ?? null;

} catch (_) {}

return {

token,

actor: doc,

sourceTokenUuid: token?.document?.uuid ?? token?.uuid ?? null,

sourceActorUuid: doc?.uuid ?? null

};

}

if (doc?.actor) {

const token = doc?.object ?? null;

return {

token,

actor: doc.actor,

sourceTokenUuid: token?.document?.uuid ?? token?.uuid ?? null,

sourceActorUuid: doc.actor?.uuid ?? null

};

}

}

const actorRefs = uniq([

evt?.sourceActorUuid,

evt?.attackerActorUuid,

evt?.actorUuid,

evt?.subjectActorUuid

]);

for (const ref of actorRefs) {

const doc = await docFromUuidSafe(ref);

if (!doc) continue;

const actor = (doc?.documentName === "Actor") ? doc : (doc?.actor ?? null);

if (!actor) continue;

let token = null;

try {

token = actor.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? actor.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ?? null;

} catch (_) {}

return {

token,

actor,

sourceTokenUuid: token?.document?.uuid ?? token?.uuid ?? null,

sourceActorUuid: actor?.uuid ?? null

};

}

return {

token: null,

actor: null,

sourceTokenUuid: null,

sourceActorUuid: null

};

}

function getDisposition(docOrTokenOrActor) {

const d =

docOrTokenOrActor?.document?.disposition ??

docOrTokenOrActor?.disposition ??

docOrTokenOrActor?.prototypeToken?.disposition ??

null;

if (d === -2) return 0;

if (d === 1) return 1;

if (d === -1) return -1;

return 0;

}

function isSameSide(a, b) {

if (a === 0 || b === 0) return false;

return a === b;

}

function collectEventTargetRefs(evt = {}) {

const tokenRefs = uniq([

evt?.targetUuid,

evt?.targetTokenUuid,

...(Array.isArray(evt?.targetTokenUuids) ? evt.targetTokenUuids : []),

...(Array.isArray(evt?.targets) ? evt.targets : [])

]);

const actorRefs = uniq([

evt?.targetActorUuid,

...(Array.isArray(evt?.targetActorUuids) ? evt.targetActorUuids : [])

]);

return { tokenRefs, actorRefs };

}

function eventTargetsContainOwner(ownerInfo) {

const { evt } = getPhaseEvent();

const { tokenRefs, actorRefs } = collectEventTargetRefs(evt);

const ownerTokenUuid = str(ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid);

const ownerActorUuid = str(ownerInfo?.ownerActorUuid);

const tokenHit = !!ownerTokenUuid && tokenRefs.includes(ownerTokenUuid);

const actorHit = !!ownerActorUuid && actorRefs.includes(ownerActorUuid);

return tokenHit || actorHit;

}

async function setActorAdoration(actor, value) {

try {

if (!actor) return false;

const props = actor.system?.props ?? actor.system ?? {};

const keyPath = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(props, "clock_adoration")

? "system.props.clock_adoration"

: "system.clock_adoration";

const vStr = String(clamp(value, 0, 5));

await actor.update({ [keyPath]: vStr });

return true;

} catch (e) {

err("Failed to set Adoration clock:", e);

return false;

}

}

function getActorAdoration(actor) {

const props = actor?.system?.props ?? actor?.system ?? {};

const raw = props?.clock_adoration ?? 0;

const n = num(raw, 0) ?? 0;

return clamp(n, 0, 5);

}

async function showPassiveCard({ title = "Passive", icon = "🌹", anchorTokenUuid = null } = {}) {

try {

const api =

globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.passiveCard ??

globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.passiveCardBroadcast;

if (!api || (!api.broadcast && typeof api !== "function")) return false;

const call = api.broadcast ? api.broadcast : api;

const res = await call({

title,

icon,

attackerUuid: anchorTokenUuid,

actionContext: payload,

options: { yOffset: -6, holdMs: 1500 }

});

log("passive-card shown", { title, anchorTokenUuid, ok: !!res?.ok });

return !!res?.ok;

} catch (e) {

warn("passive-card show failed", e);

return false;

}

}

async function step1_CheckOwnerWasTargeted(ownerInfo) {

const { key, evt } = getPhaseEvent();

if (!eventTargetsContainOwner(ownerInfo)) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("not_targeting_owner", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step1: event did not target owner.", {

key,

ownerTokenUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid ?? null,

ownerActorUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerActorUuid ?? null,

eventTargetUuid: evt?.targetUuid ?? null,

eventTargets: Array.isArray(evt?.targets) ? evt.targets : []

});

return { ok: false, reason: "not_targeting_owner" };

}

return { ok: true };

}

async function step2_CheckEnemySource(ownerInfo) {

const source = await getSourceActorAndToken();

const ownerDisp = getDisposition(ownerInfo?.token ?? ownerInfo?.actor);

const sourceDisp = getDisposition(source?.token ?? source?.actor);

log("Step2 source/owner disposition", {

ownerName: ownerInfo?.actor?.name ?? ownerInfo?.token?.name ?? null,

sourceName: source?.actor?.name ?? source?.token?.name ?? null,

ownerDisp,

sourceDisp

});

// If source is clearly same-side friendly, block.

if (source?.actor && ownerInfo?.actor) {

if (source.actor.uuid === ownerInfo.actor.uuid) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("source_is_self", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step2: source is self.");

return { ok: false, reason: "source_is_self" };

}

}

if (sourceDisp !== 0 && ownerDisp !== 0 && isSameSide(ownerDisp, sourceDisp)) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("source_is_ally", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step2: source is ally / same side.");

return { ok: false, reason: "source_is_ally" };

}

return { ok: true };

}

async function step3_HandleMiss(ownerInfo) {

const actor = ownerInfo?.actor;

if (!actor) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_owner_actor", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL @ miss: no owner actor.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_owner_actor" };

}

const cur = getActorAdoration(actor);

const next = clamp(cur + ADORATION_GAIN_ON_MISS, 0, 5);

const ok = await setActorAdoration(actor, next);

log(`MISS: +${ADORATION_GAIN_ON_MISS} Adoration`, {

cur,

next,

updated: ok,

owner: actor?.name ?? null

});

await showPassiveCard({

title: `Pases: Adoration +${ADORATION_GAIN_ON_MISS}`,

icon: "🌹",

anchorTokenUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid ?? null

});

ctx.skipPassive?.("miss_increment_adoration", { notify: false });

return { ok: false, reason: "miss_increment_adoration" };

}

async function step4_CheckPositiveDamage() {

const { key, evt } = getPhaseEvent();

const evtFinal = num(evt?.finalValue, null);

const evtAffected = (evt?.affected === true);

const evtNoEffect = str(evt?.noEffectReason).toLowerCase();

if (key === "creature_takes_damage") {

if (evtFinal !== null) {

log("Step4 damage event.finalValue", {

evtFinal,

evtAffected,

evtNoEffect

});

if (evtFinal > 0) {

return { ok: true, estimate: evtFinal, via: "event.finalValue" };

}

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_damage_after_reduction", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step4: finalValue <= 0.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_damage" };

}

}

const estimate = computeFinalDamageEstimate();

log("Step4 fallback estimate", { estimate, advPayload: payload?.advPayload ?? null });

if (estimate <= 0) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_damage_after_reduction", { notify: false });

log("CANCEL @ step4: estimate <= 0.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_damage" };

}

return { ok: true, estimate, via: "estimate" };

}

async function step5_ResetAdorationOnDamage(ownerInfo) {

const actor = ownerInfo?.actor;

if (!actor) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_owner_actor", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL @ reset: no owner actor.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no_owner_actor" };

}

const ok = await setActorAdoration(actor, 0);

log("TAKES DAMAGE: reset Adoration to 0", {

updated: ok,

owner: actor?.name ?? null

});

ctx.skipPassive?.("hit_reset_adoration", { notify: false });

return { ok };

}

async function stepFallback_CompareAccuracy(ownerInfo) {

const chosen = chooseDefenseToUse();

const defVal = readOwnerDefense(payload?.meta?.defenseSnapshot, chosen);

const acc = readAccuracyTotal();

if (acc == null) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("accuracy_unknown", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL @ fallback compare: accuracy total unknown.", { defVal });

return { ok: false, reason: "accuracy_unknown" };

}

const isHit = acc >= defVal;

log("Fallback compare result", {

accuracyTotal: acc,

defenseUsed: defVal,

isHit

});

if (!isHit) {

return await step3_HandleMiss(ownerInfo);

}

const dmg = await step4_CheckPositiveDamage();

if (!dmg.ok) return dmg;

return await step5_ResetAdorationOnDamage(ownerInfo);

}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Execution

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(async () => {

if (!ctx?.isPassiveExecution) {

log("Non-passive execution; skipping Pases logic.");

return;

}

const ownerInfo = await getOwnerActorAndToken();

if (!ownerInfo?.ownerActorUuid && !ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid) {

ctx.skipPassive?.("no_owner_identity", { notify: false });

warn("CANCEL: could not resolve passive owner.", {

passiveItemUuid: payload?.meta?.passiveItemUuid ?? payload?.skillUuid ?? null,

attackerUuid: payload?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? payload?.attackerUuid ?? null

});

return;

}

const { key, evt } = getPhaseEvent();

log("BEGIN", {

passiveTriggerKey: key,

ownerTokenUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerTokenUuid ?? null,

ownerActorUuid: ownerInfo?.ownerActorUuid ?? null,

ownerName: ownerInfo?.actor?.name ?? ownerInfo?.token?.name ?? null,

eventPreview: {

kind: evt?.kind ?? null,

targetUuid: evt?.targetUuid ?? null,

targets: Array.isArray(evt?.targets) ? evt.targets : [],

attackerUuid: evt?.attackerUuid ?? null,

sourceUuid: evt?.sourceUuid ?? null,

finalValue: evt?.finalValue ?? null,

affected: evt?.affected ?? null,

noEffectReason: evt?.noEffectReason ?? null

}

});

const s1 = await step1_CheckOwnerWasTargeted(ownerInfo);

if (!s1.ok) return;

const s2 = await step2_CheckEnemySource(ownerInfo);

if (!s2.ok) return;

// Primary intended triggers

if (key === "creature_miss_action") {

await step3_HandleMiss(ownerInfo);

return;

}

if (key === "creature_takes_damage") {

const s4 = await step4_CheckPositiveDamage();

if (!s4.ok) return;

await step5_ResetAdorationOnDamage(ownerInfo);

return;

}

// Safety fallback for older / partial trigger setups

log("Using fallback compare path for unexpected trigger.", { key });

await stepFallback_CompareAccuracy(ownerInfo);

})();
props.description:
Each time you acquire this Skill, learn a Pass (see Facet). You may acquire this Skill multiple times.

When you first learn this skill, gain the Adoration Clock, this clock has 5 sections, Fill 1 section whenever an enemy attacks you and misses. The Adoration Clock resets to 0 whenever an enemy successfully deal damage to you with an Attack, Skill or Spell and at the end of each scene.
